title: audio playback in editor preview

commit.merge_subject: merge: audio playback in editor preview

description:
jvm tests for the editor audio path (owner request 2026-11-11 section
4), all against fakes - no android framework class is touched:

editoraudiotest (21 tests): audiosync position math including the
44.1 khz aud-06 case (1 s = 44_100 frames, never an assumed 48 khz),
floor so audio never starts ahead of video, non-positive rate/position
-> clip start; pcmclipaudiosource chunk slicing, the short last chunk,
seek clamping both ways, null-after-release; audioplaybackcore
transitions - start opens once and re-primes with pause -> flush ->
play (12_000 frames at 250 ms, 24_000 at 500 ms), addresses the clip's
own rate, a re-start reads from the new position not the old queue
(aud-08's first form), pause holds, stop drops the tail, end of audio
and a failed write and a failed open all degrade to silence, release
is exactly-once and gates every later call (no write, no second open
after it); e
changed: feat: audio playback engine for editor
